title: Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_11777__PART_3_)
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS IS_11777__PART_3_) prescribes technical specifications, requirements, tolerances, and testing procedures for Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_11777__PART_3_).

clause_2_normative_references.title: Circular Connectors for Radio and Associated Sound Equipment for Frequencies Below 3 MHz Including DC, Part 10: Free Six-Pin Connector for Various Applications Type 11777 IS-09

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
